report.description: Intercom provides a developer platform with REST APIs and SDKs to manage contacts, conversations, tickets, companies, and other support data. It supports both personal access tokens and OAuth for authentication.

evidence.claim: Intercom offers Access Token and OAuth authentication options for its API.
Intercom provides a Managed Cloud Platform (Data Connectors) with its own authentication methods.
Intercom Developer Platform includes comprehensive REST API documentation covering many resources.
Developers can self‑serve to obtain API credentials via the Intercom Developer Hub.
Intercom API supports managing contacts, conversations, tickets, and companies, indicating broad API coverage.
